newsitem.title: USA: Duke Oconee 2 S.C. nuclear unit at 100 pct.
newsitem.headline: Duke Oconee 2 S.C. nuclear unit at 100 pct.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 2 nuclear power unit has returned to full service, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Wednesday in its morning plant status report.
The unit, in Seneca, S.C., has been shut since Sept 24 after a steam pipe burst in the non-nuclear side of the plant, scalding seven workers.
The adjacent 846 MW Oconee nuclear unit 1 is expected to restart this weekend, while unit 3, also with a capacity of 846 MW, will likely resume operations sometime this month.
